description: Keyword lists for scripts/tag_wording.py (PREREG.md, Wording class; Novelty and prior claims). wording_class: classes are tried in the order given and the first with a matching keyword wins; otherwise the default. A wording-class keyword matches without regard to case from the start of a word and may be followed by further letters (repurpos matches repurposing; cause does not match because). novelty_language: a term matches without regard to case as a whole word or phrase.
